## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one reviewable goal.
- [ ] Repository facts, personal contribution, upstream capability, and user statements are kept separate.
- [ ] Tests, benchmark results, releases, and production effects are not conflated.
- [ ] No project, technology, metric, user outcome, or hiring result is invented.
- [ ] New behavior has deterministic tests or a fixed-revision eval contract where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation and examples reflect final default-branch behavior, not temporary PR state.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally, or the failure and reason are stated above.
- [ ] The change contains no private resumes, internal repositories, credentials, customer data, or generated caches.
